description: This file defines a custom encoder for Feign clients within the Apache Fineract project, specifically for handling multipart/form-data requests using Apache HttpClient's MultipartEntityBuilder. It provides logic for encoding various object types, including files and multipart data, into HTTP request bodies.

classes.name: FineractMultipartEncoder
classes.description: A custom encoder for Feign clients that constructs multipart/form-data requests using Apache HttpClient's MultipartEntityBuilder.

methods.name: FineractMultipartEncoder
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a delegate Encoder for fallback encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Main method to encode an object into the RequestTemplate, handling MultipartData, File, and String types appropriately.

methods.name: encodeFileAsMultipart
methods.description: Converts a File object into multipart form data and encodes it.

methods.name: detectContentType
methods.description: Detects the MIME type of a File, defaults to application/octet-stream if undetectable.

methods.name: encodeMultipart
methods.description: Builds multipart form data from MultipartData parts and sets the request body and headers accordingly.
